items.item: Found on x3: HUSKY D enrolled on 2 December starts on 1 January, and care on 3 December is billed uninsured
items.requirement: Connecticut's Uniform Policy Manual § 1560.10: “The beginning date of assistance for Medicaid may be one of the following: A. the first day of the first, second or third month immediately preceding the month in which the Department receives a signed application when all non-procedural eligibility requirements are met and covered medical services are received at any time during that particular month; or B. the first day of the month of application when all non-procedural eligibility requirements are met during that month” (as quoted in a DSS Office of Legal Counsel hearing decision, portal.ct.gov omel_2016_765192.pdf, read 2026-10-16; 42 CFR 435.915(a), (b)). From 1 January 2027 the retroactive months are one for expansion adults: 42 USC 1396a(a)(34) as Pub. L. 119-21 § 71112(a) amends it, “(A) in the case of an individual who is eligible for medical assistance … described in subclause (VIII) of section 1902(a)(10)(A)(i), in or after the month before the month in which the individual made application … if such individual was (or upon application would have been) eligible for such assistance at the time such care and services were furnished”, (B) the second month before for any other; § 71112(d), applications “made (or deemed to be made) on or after the first day of the first quarter beginning after December 31, 2026” (govinfo.gov, PLAW-119publ21, the statute's own text, read 2026-10-16).
